name: Busy Bee Cafe
tagline: Soul food institution that fed the civil rights movement since 1947.
description: A legendary soul food institution on MLK Jr. Drive, Busy Bee Cafe has been a cornerstone of Atlanta's civil rights history since 1947. Known for classic Southern plates, sweet tea, and warm hospitality that has welcomed civil rights icons, celebrities, and everyday neighbors for generations.

name: Twisted Soul Cookhouse & Pours
tagline: Southern soul food elevated with global flavors and craft cocktails.
description: Chef Deborah VanTrece's award-winning restaurant where Southern soul food meets global culinary traditions. Expect creative plates, inventive cocktails, and a dining experience that honors Atlanta's rich cultural identity.

name: Atlanta Breakfast Club
tagline: Iconic downtown breakfast spot for big plates and bold Atlanta flavor.
description: A downtown Atlanta institution famous for massive, flavor-packed breakfast plates served all day. With bold décor and an energetic vibe, Atlanta Breakfast Club has become a must-visit spot for locals and visitors alike.

name: Tassili's Raw Reality Cafe
tagline: Plant-based raw vegan cafe rooted in holistic living and African wellness traditions.
description: A pioneer in Atlanta's plant-based movement, Tassili's serves raw vegan cuisine rooted in holistic wellness and African traditions. The West End café is known for nourishing bowls, smoothies, and a community-centered ethos.

name: Slutty Vegan ATL
tagline: Boldly named vegan burgers that converted Atlanta into true believers.
description: Founded by Pinky Cole, Slutty Vegan disrupted Atlanta's food scene with bold, unapologetically named vegan burgers that converted even the most dedicated meat-eaters. The brand has grown into a national movement proving that plant-based food can be craveable and culturally resonant.

name: Desta Ethiopian Kitchen
tagline: Authentic Ethiopian cuisine bringing injera and bold spice to Atlanta.
description: Atlanta's premier destination for authentic Ethiopian cuisine, serving tender injera, rich stews, and fragrant spiced dishes in a warm, communal setting. A beloved fixture on Briarcliff Road bringing the depth of East African culinary tradition to Atlanta.

name: Virgil's Gullah Kitchen & Bar
tagline: Gullah Geechee coastal cuisine honoring a distinct African American culinary tradition.
description: Celebrating the distinct Gullah Geechee culinary tradition of the Sea Islands, Virgil's brings coastal South Carolina and Georgia flavors to Atlanta's Westside. Seafood-forward dishes, okra gumbo, and Southern cocktails in an elevated setting.

name: Che Butter Jonez
tagline: Creative American comfort food with bold personality in Brookhaven.
description: A Brookhaven restaurant known for inventive comfort food with big personality. Chef Jamal Kent's creative American menu changes seasonally and consistently delivers memorable, satisfying plates worth returning for.

name: Hippin' Hops Brewery
tagline: Georgia's first Black-owned brewery crafting beers with deep community spirit.
description: Georgia's first Black-owned craft brewery, bringing community spirit and great beer to Glenwood Park. Known for neighborhood events, live music, and a welcoming taproom that feels like home.

name: Big Dave's Cheesesteaks
tagline: Atlanta's beloved cheesesteak spot built from passion and pure hustle.
description: Built from pure hustle and a love of cheesesteaks, this Atlanta institution serves loaded, saucy sandwiches that have earned a devoted following. Chef David McIntosh's shop is a go-to for big flavor at accessible prices.

name: Shorthair Xpress
tagline: Atlanta's go-to destination for precision short haircuts and expert styling.
description: Edgewood Avenue's premier destination for precision short haircuts, featuring expert stylists who specialize in tapered cuts, pixie styles, and short naturals. A welcoming environment for women who celebrate the confidence of short hair.

name: Textur'd Silk Bar
tagline: Silk press and textured hair specialists for every crown and curl.
description: Atlanta's specialist for silk press, Dominican blowouts, and textured natural hair styling. Known for healthy hair practices that prioritize moisture retention and long-term hair health in every appointment.

name: Dawn's of Essence Salon
tagline: Upscale ethnic hair salon committed to healthy hair care for Black women.
description: An upscale ethnic hair salon in Atlanta committed to healthy hair care for Black women. Offering everything from relaxers and color to natural styling in a warm, professional setting where clients feel seen and celebrated.

name: Gymnetics Fitness
tagline: Atlanta's first Black women-owned fitness center powering community wellness.
description: Atlanta's first Black women-owned fitness center, empowering community members with group fitness classes, personal training, and a welcoming space where wellness feels accessible to everyone. Founded in 2010 with a mission to make health a priority in Southwest Atlanta.

name: The Kindred Healing Center
tagline: Holistic healing collective offering culturally competent Black wellness services.
description: A holistic healing collective on Jonesboro Road offering culturally competent wellness services including therapy, reiki, and wellness coaching. Built for and by the Black community, Kindred prioritizes safety, healing, and whole-person care.

name: E.F.F.E.C.T. Fitness
tagline: High-energy boot camp and spin classes built for the Southwest Atlanta community.
description: High-energy boot camp classes, indoor cycling, and functional fitness training designed to transform lives on Atlanta's southwest side. A tight-knit community focused on accountability, results, and the joy of moving together.

name: The Wellness Spot ATL
tagline: Full-service spa and wellness studio rooted in restorative community self-care.
description: A full-service spa and wellness studio in East Point offering massage therapy, facials, and restorative bodywork. Built on the belief that Black women deserve dedicated spaces for rest, recovery, and deep self-care.

name: Pressed ATL
tagline: Midtown boutique empowering women to feel bold and beautifully confident.
description: Midtown Atlanta's destination boutique for women who lead with confidence. Pressed ATL curates contemporary fashion that celebrates individuality and empowers women to show up boldly in every room they enter.

name: The Village Retail Market
tagline: Cause-driven collective boutique celebrating Black-owned fashion and culture.
description: A cause-driven boutique collective at Ponce City Market celebrating Black-owned fashion, accessories, and culture. Part of a broader mission to support Black entrepreneurs and connect community through meaningful commerce.
address_line_1: 675 Ponce De Leon Ave NE Suite 225

name: Atlanta Influences Everything
tagline: Atlanta-born apparel brand celebrating the city's global cultural influence.
description: The apparel brand born from Atlanta's undeniable influence on global culture. AIE drops streetwear and lifestyle pieces that honor the city's music, art, and creative energy for those who represent the ATL everywhere they go.

name: TKST Law
tagline: Atlanta's oldest Black-owned law firm with decades of elite corporate litigation excellence.
description: Founded in 1971, Thomas Kennedy Sampson & Tompkins is one of the oldest and most respected Black-owned law firms in Atlanta. The firm handles complex commercial litigation, business transactions, and has represented some of the most consequential cases in Georgia's legal history.

name: SR Law Group
tagline: Georgia's premier Black-owned boutique firm for estate planning and elder law.
description: A premier Black-owned boutique law firm in Atlanta specializing in estate planning, elder law, and business formation. Founded with a commitment to protecting the wealth and legacy of Black families and entrepreneurs across Georgia.

name: The Embry Law Firm
tagline: Black-owned personal injury firm fighting for justice with compassion and results.
description: Atlanta's trusted Black-owned personal injury firm fighting for justice on behalf of injury victims throughout Georgia. The team combines aggressive advocacy with genuine compassion for every client they serve.

name: Myavana
tagline: AI-powered hair technology helping textured hair find the right products.
description: An Atlanta-based AI platform helping women with textured hair identify the best products for their specific hair type through advanced machine learning. Founded by Candace Mitchell Harris, Myavana makes personalized hair care science accessible for Black women everywhere.

name: Zyrobotics
tagline: Inclusive assistive technology making STEM learning joyful for children with disabilities.
description: A Georgia Tech spinoff developing inclusive assistive technology and STEM educational tools for children with disabilities. Co-founded by Dr. Ayanna Howard, Zyrobotics has earned global recognition for making learning joyful and accessible for every child.

name: Brave + Kind Bookshop
tagline: Decatur's children's bookshop championing diverse stories and representation.
description: Decatur's beloved children's bookshop dedicated to diverse stories and representation in literature. Brave + Kind champions books that help every child see themselves as the hero of their own story, serving families across metro Atlanta.

name: For Keeps Books
tagline: Auburn Avenue shop specializing in rare and classic Black literature and history.
description: Nestled on Auburn Avenue in the heart of Atlanta's historic Black neighborhood, For Keeps Books specializes in rare, classic, and contemporary African American literature. An essential stop for collectors and readers who know the power of Black storytelling.

name: WEBMyers Construction
tagline: Georgia's largest Black woman-owned general contracting firm with 25+ years of expertise.
description: One of Georgia's largest Black woman-owned general contracting firms, delivering commercial construction and project management with 25+ years of proven excellence. WEBMyers has completed projects across healthcare, education, government, and mixed-use development.

name: Design OCD
tagline: Premier Black-owned interior design firm transforming Atlanta homes and commercial spaces.
description: Metro Atlanta's premier Black-owned interior design firm transforming residential and commercial spaces with sophisticated, tailored aesthetics. Known for meticulous attention to detail and an ability to translate client visions into extraordinary environments.

name: ZuCot Gallery
tagline: The Southeast's largest African American-owned fine art gallery showcasing diverse artists.
description: The Southeast's largest African American-owned fine art gallery, showcasing original paintings, sculpture, and mixed media from emerging and established Black artists. ZuCot has been a cornerstone of Atlanta's visual arts community since 2009, amplifying Black creativity and collecting.

name: CreativeSoul Photography
tagline: Atlanta photographers creating powerful images celebrating Black children and culture.
description: Atlanta's nationally celebrated photography studio known for powerful, joyful images of Black children that challenge outdated stereotypes and celebrate Black childhood in all its beauty. Their iconic portraiture has been featured in major publications worldwide.

name: Urban Grind Atlanta
tagline: Hip Westside coffee house and co-working space fueling Atlanta's creative class.
description: A community coffee house and co-working space on Atlanta's Westside where creatives, entrepreneurs, and neighbors gather to work, connect, and create. Known for its warm vibe, strong coffee, and genuine commitment to the local creative economy.

name: Nourish + Bloom Market
tagline: The world's first AI-powered frictionless Black-owned grocery store.
description: The world's first AI-powered frictionless Black-owned grocery store, serving Southwest Atlanta with fresh produce, healthy staples, and the convenience of checkout-free shopping. A landmark in food access innovation and community investment on Cascade Road.

name: The Beehive ATL
tagline: Boutique collective of local makers selling apparel, jewelry, and home goods.
description: A vibrant collective boutique in Inman Park carrying local makers' apparel, jewelry, home goods, and art. The Beehive is a living marketplace for Atlanta's creative community, offering something new with every visit.

name: Images USA
tagline: Atlanta's pioneering Black-owned multicultural marketing agency serving brands for 35+ years.
description: Atlanta's pioneering Black-owned multicultural marketing agency, founded in 1988 and serving Fortune 500 brands with authentic, research-driven campaigns. Images USA has spent over three decades crafting communications that resonate deeply with diverse audiences.

name: Tony's Barber Studio
tagline: Upscale barbershop bringing luxury cuts and straight-razor shaves to Midtown Atlanta.
description: An upscale barbershop at Atlantic Station bringing precision cuts, hot towel shaves, and a premium grooming experience to Midtown Atlanta. Tony's is where Atlanta's style-conscious men invest in their look and their confidence.

name: Chapter Ave Productions
tagline: Full-service video production and digital marketing agency for visionary brands.
description: A full-service video production and digital content company serving brands across metro Atlanta. Chapter Ave specializes in brand storytelling, documentary content, and commercial production that moves audiences and builds lasting brand equity.

name: Centered Life Therapy
tagline: Mental health counseling that honors your full humanity and cultural identity.
description: An Atlanta-based mental health practice offering individual and group therapy rooted in culturally informed care. Serving Black clients who deserve therapeutic support that truly honors their full lived experience, history, and humanity.

name: Just 4 Girls Salon
tagline: Specialized hair salon dedicated to girls and women of all hair types and ages.
description: A specialized hair salon in the Kennesaw area dedicated to providing excellent hair care for girls and women of all ages and textures. Known for a nurturing atmosphere and stylists who truly understand and celebrate Black hair.

name: Gymnetics Fitness East
tagline: Community fitness center empowering Atlanta's east side through accessible wellness.
description: A community fitness center on Atlanta's east side offering group classes, personal training, and wellness programming for all fitness levels. Built on the principle that access to quality fitness should not depend on geography or income.
